generation_latency_ms.source: provider-reported completion latency, replayed from transcript

wall_clock.note: Wall clock covers queueing, connection setup and cloud scheduling as well as generation. It is measured only for calls actually made in this invocation; a fully resumed pass reports measured=false rather than reusing an earlier run's number.

latency_policy: The Stage 3 cost model prices the LLM at measured wall clock, not at generation time, and records that cloud throughput is not constant. Audio is priced at its measured Stage 1 per-sample latency.

llm_config.note: Stage 3 changes which samples the LLM is asked about, never how it is asked. Model, prompt, decoding parameters and uncertainty policy are the Stage 2 frozen values.
